newsitem.title: USA: Man Sang Holdings sees FY97 eps $1.40.
newsitem.headline: Man Sang Holdings sees FY97 eps $1.40.

text.p: Man Sang Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it is projecting that its earnings for fiscal year 1997 will be $5.3 million, or $1.40 per share.

"Our net income has been improving every year. I believe that Man Sang is on target to achieve a growth rate of more than 350 percent for net sales and net income by the year 2001," said Ricky Cheng, chairman.
The company is a supplier of freshwater, cultured and South Sea pearls with headquarters in Hong Kong.
